services.name: Rental Spaces
services.desc: A large-stepped area, or “reverse stoop,” creates a generous, versatile space for performances, panel discussions, film screenings, and lectures. The scale of the Stoop refers to the soaring cathedral-like interiors of local churches and its shape to Harlem’s classic brownstone stoops.Capacity:1,231 sqft133
